name: Bissektipelta
sum: Bissektipelta is an ankylosaurid from the Turonian Bissekty Formation of Uzbekistan, known from a braincase.
holotype: ZIN PH 1/6, a fully ossified braincase with a partial skull roof, teeth and osteoderms — Bissekty Formation, Dzharakuduk, Uzbekistan.
biology: The braincase has been studied for brain morphology (Alifanov and Saveliev 2019; Kuzmin et al. 2020).
author: Parish and Barrett 2004

sources.text: Parish, J. C.; Barrett, P. M. 2004. A reappraisal of the ornithischian dinosaur ''Amtosaurus magnus'' Kurzanov and Tumanova 1978, with comments on the status of ''A. archibaldi'' Averianov 2002. Canadian Journal of Earth Sciences 41(3): 299–306. doi:10.1139/e03-101
